excerpts.locator: Natural gas storage: October 31 inventory forecast
excerpts.quote: We forecast U.S. working natural gas inventories will total 3,969 billion cubic feet (Bcf) on October 31, 2026, 5% above the previous five-year average (2021–2025) and 1% above October 2025 levels.

excerpts.locator: Natural gas production: national marketed output forecast
excerpts.quote: U.S. marketed natural gas production continues to grow in our forecast, providing additional supply to meet demand and support storage additions. Production increases by 4.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026 and 4.6 Bcf/d in 2027.
